audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer stages contradict their own sides: Level 1 is Skill but carries "Three-hit passive trades win level 1", Level 2 and Level 3 are Gangplank but carry Akshan-favoured boilerplate, and First item / 2+ items are Gangplank under "Take over the lane and start roaming".
audit.why: Gangplank can place a Powder Keg from level 1 and Parrrley is a flat 4.5s, so he is not a champion you out-trade by walking up early. The content layer already grades levels 1-3 his way; the full layer's stage text was never reconciled.
audit.corrected: Each contradicted stage now states the Gangplank-side reason: the level-1 keg, chained kegs beating your Q max, crit detonations at first item, and Cannon Barrage plus crit kegs at two.

audit.why: The spike stages hold up: Akshan at 2-3 pre-chain, Akshan at 6 with Comeuppance (100/85/70), Gangplank at his first crit item, Gangplank at two items with Cannon Barrage (160/140/120). The content layer carries all four.

audit.whatIsWrong: Remove Scurvy is described in five strings as cleansing YOUR crowd control — "cleanse your follow-up CC", "shrugs your follow-up CC", "cleanses any catch CC you'd buy to lock him", "so it isn't up to cleanse your Heroic Swing follow-up". Cannon Barrage is also called simply "global R" with no reach given.
audit.why: Akshan's kit contains no crowd control at all — Dirty Fighting, Avengerang, Going Rogue, Heroic Swing and Comeuppance carry no stun, root, slow or knockup — and Heroic Swing is a grapple, not CC. Remove Scurvy's cleanse is therefore irrelevant in this matchup; what actually matters is its heal on a 22/20/18/16/14s cooldown. Telling the reader to bait the cleanse points them at the wrong half of the ability. Cannon Barrage's 30000 range is worth stating outright, since it means he contests every objective on the map from lane.
audit.corrected: All five strings now key off the 22s heal instead of a cleanse that cannot apply, one of them saying plainly that you carry no CC for it. Cannon Barrage now carries its 30000 range.

edits.before: Level 1 GP can already drop a Powder Keg and poke, so don't walk up to land a Q he can answer with a detonation — concede the level and last-hit at range. From 2 onward your passive double-shot and Q out-trade him in the windows where his barrels aren't chained: shoot the keg the moment he places it so it never explodes, then chip him with the boomerang and your second shot. The thing to dodge is the stacked keg — never trade standing next to two of them, and bait his W (Remove Scurvy) before you commit your all-in so it isn't up to cleanse your Heroic Swing follow-up.
edits.after: Level 1 GP can already drop a Powder Keg and poke, so don't walk up to land a Q he can answer with a detonation — concede the level and last-hit at range. From 2 onward your passive double-shot and Q out-trade him in the windows where his barrels aren't chained: shoot the keg the moment he places it so it never explodes, then chip him with the boomerang and your second shot. The thing to dodge is the stacked keg — never trade standing next to two of them, and bait his W (Remove Scurvy) before you commit, because its 22s heal, not any cleanse, is what undoes your all-in.

edits.before: You lose the long game outright — GP is a hard scaler whose crit Powder Kegs, global R and item spikes out-grow your lethality, and his W cleanses any catch CC you'd buy to lock him. Once he has two items your double-shot chip bounces off and his keg chains delete you, squishy and shieldless as you are. Win it before then: snowball your 2-6 edge into plates, and use Comeuppance plus your Heroic Swing mobility to roam and hand your team a lead, because if this reaches three items GP is using you for target practice across the whole map with his global ult.
edits.after: You lose the long game outright — GP is a hard scaler whose crit Powder Kegs, 30000-range Cannon Barrage and item spikes out-grow your lethality, and Remove Scurvy heals a chunk back every 22 seconds on top. Win it before then: snowball your 2-6 edge into plates, and use Comeuppance plus your Heroic Swing mobility to roam and hand your team a lead, because if this reaches three items GP is using you for target practice across the whole map with his global ult.

notes: The packet flagged wants.foe[2]'s 'Powder Kegs' as a suspect name — it is just the plural of Powder Keg and was not the real defect. The kit file lists Powder Keg's cooldown as 0 because it is charge-based and the charge timer is not in Riot's data, so the page's 'while the keg is on cooldown' phrasing was left alone rather than replaced with a number I cannot source. Full-layer focus.text still reads 'Gangplank Powder Kegs (Barrels)'; correcting it to 'Powder Keg' would drop the string well outside the length band, so it is flagged here instead.
